decision_delta: Greyhound heavy read-only agent and offline filesystem work advanced from an established unbounded-scan risk to a repository-owned exact-root wrapper that verifies cgroup-v2 physical-read ceilings, defaults to one worker and safe exclusions, cleans up on timeout or interruption, and was measured without disrupting natural odds collection.
new_evidence: Docker 29.1.3 on cgroup v2/systemd applied and exposed io.max 259:2 rbps=1048576 riops=16 while the user manager lacked the io controller.
Eighteen focused tests plus compilation, diff hygiene, unsafe-root rejection, exact-root hash, test discovery, and representative bounded-search smokes passed.
The controlled process interval attributed 1318912 physical read bytes to the child versus 1306624 whole-device read bytes while the host remained interactively responsive.
Two natural odds-capture executions completed successfully during the bounded scan, with no service or database mutation.
resume_only_if: The wrapper, canonical host cgroup/Docker support, exclusion policy, live collection safety evidence, or draft-PR state changes after this closeout.
